q.t: Simplify: (a + b)(a − b) + (b + c)(b − c) + (c + a)(c − a)
q.e: a² − b² + b² − c² + c² − a². Every square appears once with + and once with −, so everything cancels.
Square: x² − 2 + 1/x² = 9, so x² + 1/x² = 11. Square again: x⁴ + 2 + 1/x⁴ = 121, so the answer is 119.

q.t: What is the remainder when x² + 5x + 9 is divided by (x + 2)?
q.e: x² + 5x + 9 = (x + 2)(x + 3) + 3, since (x + 2)(x + 3) = x² + 5x + 6. The 3 left over is the remainder.
